sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 333)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC), and syndication, Joe DeSantis starring as Captain John Drake smashing counterfeit bond rings on *Under Arrest* (1948), Robert Fontaine's coming-of-age classic *The Happy Time* on *Best Sellers* (1945), Jim French's Victorian duel mystery on CBC *The Mystery Project*, *Mysterious Circumstances*, Kansas history on *This Is Wichita*, and *Hearts in Harmony* for Kroger (1941–1998):
